body:
✨ Added

  • Introduced quick search with fuzzy matching.

  • Added keyboard shortcuts for common actions.

  • New dark mode accent color options.

  • Export reports as CSV and JSON.

🚀 Improved

  • Reduced application startup time by ~30%.

  • Improved responsiveness on low-memory devices.

  • Enhanced error messages with clearer troubleshooting hints.

  • Optimized database queries for faster dashboard loading.

🐛 Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where notifications appeared twice.

  • Resolved occasional crashes when uploading large files.

  • Corrected incorrect date formatting in some regions.

  • Fixed a bug causing user preferences to reset after updates.

🔒 Security

  • Updated third-party dependencies to address known vulnerabilities.

  • Improved session validation and token expiration handling.

🛠️ Developer

  • Refactored authentication module for easier maintenance.

  • Expanded unit test coverage for API endpoints.

  • Updated CI pipeline to reduce build times.

⚠️ Known Issues

  • Rare UI flickering may occur when switching themes rapidly.

  • Some legacy plugins require updates for full compatibility.
